subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Bernie Madoff's $65 Billion Fraud
description: Learn Bernie Madoff's $65 Billion Fraud in one minute.

hook.text: Bernie Madoff ran the largest Ponzi scheme in history — $65 billion over at least 17 years.

buildup.text: He was a former NASDAQ chairman. Investors trusted him because of his Wall Street reputation.

discovery.text: He promised steady 10-12% annual returns regardless of market conditions. Nobody questioned it.

twist.text: Harry Markopolos warned the SEC repeatedly for a decade. The regulators ignored every warning.

climax.text: Madoff confessed in 2008 when the financial crisis triggered too many withdrawals at once.

punchline.text: The SEC missed the biggest fraud in history — for a decade.

quiz.question: Who repeatedly warned the SEC about Madoff's fraud?
